purpose: record-local mixed EEG band-power baseline for brainprint identification; not pure periodic decomposition
additional_time_domain_preprocessing: none; preserve supplied DC-removed data, original reference and all channels
quality_masks: retained for diagnostics; not used for dropping, zeroing or imputing signal
integration: trapezoidal integral of LINEAR PSD, including aligned low/high boundary nodes; adjacent bands share trapezoidal endpoint weights, not full duplicated bins
log_power: log10(integrated native-amplitude-squared power), not 10*log10 and not log of PSD before integration
relative_power: band integral / same-record same-channel 1-40 Hz integral; computed before log
zero_power_policy: flag invalid_power_channel; finite floor for log and zero relative placeholder; never automatically assign identity 0

output.within_block_order: channel order above; within each channel theta, alpha, beta
output.global_key: record_id or full path; sample alone is not unique in Train
output.model_standardization: not applied here; fit only on the training partition during later model development

selection_evidence.sampling: 20 identities x 4 tasks x 6 records, fixed seed 20261102
selection_evidence.status: frozen implementation baseline, not recognition-performance optimum
observations: 50 Hz trough and steep high-frequency attenuation visible in train spectra; upstream filtering is an inference, not verified provenance
no sampled record met the declared multichannel line-noise flag
2s uses three Welch segments; 4s uses only one
